{% liquid
  assign block_settings = block.settings
  assign product = closest.product
  if request.visual_preview_mode and product == blank
    assign product = collections.all.products.first
  endif

  assign variant = closest.product.selected_or_first_available_variant
  assign inventory_quantity = variant.inventory_quantity
  assign inventory_policy = variant.inventory_policy

  endif

    if variant.quantity_rule.min > variant.inventory_quantity and inventory_managed and inventory_policy == 'deny'

   Rules: no CSS transforms on any ancestor of a nail element (the controller measures the offset chain);

"""stage_put.py <xgoogdate> <local> <uuid/filename> <signature> [mime]  -> PUT + verify md5 via public GET"""
import sys, subprocess, hashlib
date, local, path, sig = sys.argv[1:5]; mime = sys.argv[5] if len(sys.argv) > 5 else 'text/plain'
B = "https://shopify-staged-uploads.storage.googleapis.com/tmp/83023397077/files/"
Q = ("?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=merchant-assets%40shopify-tiers.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
     "%2F20261009%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=" + date + "&X-Goog-Expires=604800&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-Signature=" + sig)
put = subprocess.run(["curl", "-s", "-o", "/dev/null", "-w", "%{http_code}", "-X", "PUT", "-H", "Content-Type: " + mime, "--data-binary", "@" + local, B + path + Q], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
body = subprocess.run(["curl", "-s", B + path], capture_output=True).stdout
ok = hashlib.md5(body).hexdigest() == hashlib.md5(open(local, 'rb').read()).hexdigest()
print(put, 'md5-ok' if ok else 'MD5-MISMATCH', B + path)

{% doc %}
  Gated group. Holds copy or a form whose register row depends on an unconfirmed fact gate (G1–G16, D1–D9).
  On the storefront its children render only once "Confirmed" is on; until then nothing is output, so no
  filler or placeholder ever reaches shoppers. In the theme editor the children stay visible inside a dashed
  frame labelled with the gate, so they can still be edited.
{% enddoc %}

{%- liquid
  assign held = true
  if block.settings.confirmed
    assign held = false
  endif
-%}

{%- if held == false or request.design_mode -%}
  <div class="st-gate{% if held %} st-gate--held{% endif %}" {{ block.shopify_attributes }}>
    {%- if held -%}
      <p class="st-gate__label">Hidden on the storefront until {{ block.settings.gate | default: 'its gate' | escape }} is confirmed.</p>
    {%- endif -%}
    {% content_for 'blocks' %}
  </div>
{%- endif -%}

{% stylesheet %}

{% doc %}
  Renders one campaign nail from the set's Phase 1 sprite (theme asset st-nails-<key>.webp: 3 cells
  signature | accent | extra, 204×354, cuticle anchor 0.5 / 0.925) as a `.st-nail` cell — the same element
  the hero motion controller uses. Role 'character' renders the campaign character from the placeholder
  atlas (metaobject character_art) through st-sprite, with class `st-art` so it never inherits `.st-nail`.

  @param {metaobject} campaign - small_talk_campaign entry.
  @param {string} [role] - 'signature' (default), 'accent', 'extra' or 'character'.
  @param {string} [class] - Extra class on the element.
  @param {string} [sizes] - sizes for the character atlas.
  @param {string} [loading] - Character only: 'eager' or 'lazy'.

"""stage_put.py <xgoogdate> <local> <uuid/filename> <signature> [mime]  -> PUT + verify md5 via public GET"""
import sys, subprocess, hashlib
date, local, path, sig = sys.argv[1:5]; mime = sys.argv[5] if len(sys.argv) > 5 else 'text/plain'
B = "https://shopify-staged-uploads.storage.googleapis.com/tmp/83023397077/files/"
Q = ("?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=merchant-assets%40shopify-tiers.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
     "%2F20261009%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=" + date + "&X-Goog-Expires=604800&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-Signature=" + sig)
put = subprocess.run(["curl", "-s", "-o", "/dev/null", "-w", "%{http_code}", "-X", "PUT", "-H", "Content-Type: " + mime, "--data-binary", "@" + local, B + path + Q], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
body = subprocess.run(["curl", "-s", B + path], capture_output=True).stdout
ok = hashlib.md5(body).hexdigest() == hashlib.md5(open(local, 'rb').read()).hexdigest()
print(put, 'md5-ok' if ok else 'MD5-MISMATCH', B + path)

<script>
  (() => {
    const thumbs = document.querySelector('[data-st-pdp-thumbs="{{ track_id }}"]');
    const track = document.getElementById('{{ track_id }}');
    if (!thumbs || !track) return;
    const buttons = [...thumbs.querySelectorAll('button[data-slide]')];
    // aria-current needs the value "true": an empty value (toggleAttribute) reads as false to assistive tech.
    const mark = (n) =>
      buttons.forEach((b) => (b.dataset.slide === String(n) ? b.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true') : b.removeAttribute('aria-current')));
    buttons.forEach((b) =>
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const slide = document.getElementById('{{ track_id }}-' + b.dataset.slide);
        track.scrollTo({ left: slide.offsetLeft - track.offsetLeft, behavior: matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
        mark(b.dataset.slide);
      })
    );
    track.addEventListener('scroll', () => mark(Math.round(track.scrollLeft / track.clientWidth) + 1), { passive: true });
  })();
</script>

{% doc %}
  Prints a campaign's scene colours as CSS custom properties for an inline style attribute:
  --st-scene, --st-scene-ink, --st-cta-bg, --st-cta-ink.
  Contrast guard: if the campaign's CTA text colour is below 4.5:1 on its CTA background, the scene
  ink is used, then the brand ink. Shared metaobject data is never changed.

  @param {metaobject} campaign - small_talk_campaign entry.

  <div style="{% render 'st-campaign-colors', campaign: c %}">

  assign scene = campaign.background.value | append: '' | default: '#EEE8F5'
  assign scene_ink = campaign.foreground.value | append: '' | default: '#1F1A2E'
  assign cta_bg = campaign.cta_background.value | append: '' | default: '#1013B3'
  assign cta_ink = campaign.cta_foreground.value | append: '' | default: '#FFFDF5'

  assign ratio = cta_bg | color_contrast: cta_ink
  if ratio < 4.5

    if ratio_scene >= 4.5

      else

"""stage_batch.py <targets.txt>: each line "local_path<TAB>staged_url<TAB>mime". PUTs the file to the signed staged URL,
re-downloads the public copy and checks its md5. Prints one line per file and the resourceUrl to use in themeFilesUpsert."""
import sys, subprocess, hashlib

ok = True
for line in open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'):
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    local, url, mime = line.split('\t')
    base = url.split('?')[0]
    put = subprocess.run(['curl', '-s', '-o', '/dev/null', '-w', '%{http_code}', '-X', 'PUT', '-H', 'Content-Type: ' + mime,
                          '--data-binary', '@' + local, url], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    body = subprocess.run(['curl', '-s', base], capture_output=True).stdout
    same = hashlib.md5(body).hexdigest() == hashlib.md5(open(local, 'rb').read()).hexdigest()
    ok &= put == '200' and same
    print(put, 'md5-ok' if same else 'MD5-MISMATCH', local, base)
print('ALL OK' if ok else 'PROBLEMS')

/**
 * Adds ArrowLeft / ArrowRight to Horizon's product media gallery when focus is inside it.
 * Uses the slideshow component's own previous()/next(); thumbnails and arrow buttons stay native.
 */
const handleKeydown = (event) => {
  if (event.key !== 'ArrowLeft' && event.key !== 'ArrowRight') return;
  if (!(event.target instanceof Element)) return;
  if (event.target.closest('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable]')) return;

  const slideshow = event.target.closest('media-gallery slideshow-component');
  if (!slideshow || typeof slideshow.next !== 'function') return;

  event.preventDefault();
  const forward = (event.key === 'ArrowRight') !== (document.dir === 'rtl');
  if (forward) slideshow.next();
  else slideshow.previous();
};

if (!window.stGalleryKeys) {
  window.stGalleryKeys = true;
  document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown);
}
```

"""stage_batch.py <targets.txt>: each line "local_path<TAB>staged_url<TAB>mime". PUTs the file to the signed staged URL,
re-downloads the public copy and checks its md5. Prints one line per file and the resourceUrl to use in themeFilesUpsert."""
import sys, subprocess, hashlib

ok = True
for line in open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'):
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    local, url, mime = line.split('\t')
    base = url.split('?')[0]
    put = subprocess.run(['curl', '-s', '-o', '/dev/null', '-w', '%{http_code}', '-X', 'PUT', '-H', 'Content-Type: ' + mime,
                          '--data-binary', '@' + local, url], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    body = subprocess.run(['curl', '-s', base], capture_output=True).stdout
    same = hashlib.md5(body).hexdigest() == hashlib.md5(open(local, 'rb').read()).hexdigest()
    ok &= put == '200' and same
    print(put, 'md5-ok' if same else 'MD5-MISMATCH', local, base)
print('ALL OK' if ok else 'PROBLEMS')

"""stage_batch.py <targets.txt>: each line "local_path<TAB>staged_url<TAB>mime". PUTs the file to the signed staged URL,
re-downloads the public copy and checks its md5. Prints one line per file and the resourceUrl to use in themeFilesUpsert."""
import sys, subprocess, hashlib

ok = True
for line in open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'):
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    local, url, mime = line.split('\t')
    base = url.split('?')[0]
    put = subprocess.run(['curl', '-s', '-o', '/dev/null', '-w', '%{http_code}', '-X', 'PUT', '-H', 'Content-Type: ' + mime,
                          '--data-binary', '@' + local, url], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    body = subprocess.run(['curl', '-s', base], capture_output=True).stdout
    same = hashlib.md5(body).hexdigest() == hashlib.md5(open(local, 'rb').read()).hexdigest()
    ok &= put == '200' and same
    print(put, 'md5-ok' if same else 'MD5-MISMATCH', local, base)
print('ALL OK' if ok else 'PROBLEMS')
```
</details>

{% doc %}
  The Small Talk logo inside a home link: the official logo image once st-artwork's files are in the theme (an SVG, or
  2× / 3× WebP), else the live-text wordmark. The link's accessible name is "Small Talk home" (locale
  small_talk.header.home = MC-004): the image's alt (MC-096 header and drawer, MC-097 footer), or visually-hidden text
  beside the aria-hidden wordmark. Box heights (css px): header 56, drawer 45, footer 72, footer-inner 50
  (header ~84 × 56 per spec/hero.md; footer ~100 × 72 per spec/landing.md; inner footer 50 tall per spec/talks.md).

  @param {string} [size] - 'header' (default), 'drawer', 'footer' or 'footer-inner'.

  @example
  <a class="st-logo" href="{{ routes.root_url }}"><span class="visually-hidden">…</span>{% render 'st-logo-mark', size: 'header' %}</a>
{% enddoc %}
{%- liquid
  # Switch, set when the official files land: '' = live text; 'svg' = assets/st-logo.svg; 'webp' = st-logo@2x.webp +

  # The image needs its intrinsic size (width / height attributes → aspect ratio, so nothing shifts on load).
  if logo_w == 0 or logo_h == 0
    assign logo_kind = ''
  endif
-%}
{%- case logo_kind -%}

That covers Pinky Promise, the tall-phone fix and the new desktop hero. The desktop scaling fix was dropped, because st-fable's desktop chapter design will replace it.

**Written:** the three landing files and the hero v3.8 stylesheet. Each matches the version the orchestrator approved, byte for byte. An earlier grant message had asked me to include the desktop fix after all. I had half rebuilt it when the final grant dropped it, so I reverted that and confirmed the files came out identical to the approved ones before uploading.

**Phones:**
- **One screen per chapter:** every chapter is exactly one screen at all three Safari-bar sizes. The only exception is Pinky Promise, whose artwork runs 28, 12 and 4 px past the bottom, as st-fable allowed. Its copy, nails, name, "Shop set" and caption all stay on screen, her eyes are clear of the button, and the whole clasp shows.
- **Tall phones:** chapters now stop just under the artwork, so the empty band is gone. At 440×956 they run 710–887 px tall against an 887 px screen.

**Desktop hero (v3.8):** at 1280×720, 1440×800 and 1536×703 it shows the new layout: finger in the middle, character on the left, note, headline and "Shop" button on the right. I shot all seven set states before and after, and checked that the hero still meets the next section cleanly. On phones the hero is unchanged; 390×844 was pixel-identical in every state the tool could compare cleanly. The first state's before shot caught the opening animation mid-fade, so I fixed the tool to wait for it.

No page errors, the dashed line runs unbroken, and nothing scrolls sideways. The landing chapters on desktop are still taller than the screen; st-fable's desktop chapter design is next.

The screenshots are in `qa/fidelity/` (`after-pinky-fix1-*` and `after-hero-v38-*`, plus two summary sheets). The record is §75 in [build-log-foundation.md](build-log-foundation.md).

fly({ from, to, sprite, col, duration, lift = 0.35, fadeTarget = true, hideFrom = true, arc = true }) {
      const a = this.anchorOf(from), b = this.anchorOf(to);
      const flyer = this.makeFlyer(sprite, col, b.w, b.h);
      const s0 = b.w ? a.w / b.w : 1;
      const liftPx = -Math.min(72, b.h * lift);
      const mid = { x: (a.x + b.x) / 2, y: (a.y + b.y) / 2 + (arc ? liftPx : 0) };
      const frames = [
        { transform: this.transformAt(a, b.w, b.h, a.rot, s0), easing: 'cubic-bezier(.4,0,.6,1)' },
        { transform: this.transformAt(mid, b.w, b.h, (a.rot + b.rot) / 2, (s0 + 1) / 2), easing: 'cubic-bezier(.3,0,.2,1)' },
        { transform: this.transformAt(b, b.w, b.h, b.rot, 1) },
      ];
      if (hideFrom) from.classList.add('is-hidden');
      const jobs = [this.run(flyer, frames, { duration })];
      // v3.3: keep the old nail until the flyer has nearly landed on it, then hand over underneath it, so the finger
      // never shows its bare natural nail mid-flight (visible at the board scale).
      if (fadeTarget) jobs.push(this.run(to, [{ opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 1, offset: 0.8 }, { opacity: 0 }], { duration }));
      return Promise.all(jobs).finally(() => flyer.remove());
    }

  success message (PG-059) promise a reply, which is fact G8 (a working, staffed contact channel). A form

    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    local, url, mime = line.split('\t')
    base = url.split('?')[0]
    put = subprocess.run(['curl', '-s', '-o', '/dev/null', '-w', '%{http_code}', '-X', 'PUT', '-H', 'Content-Type: ' + mime,
                          '--data-binary', '@' + local, url], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    body = subprocess.run(['curl', '-s', base], capture_output=True).stdout
    same = hashlib.md5(body).hexdigest() == hashlib.md5(open(local, 'rb').read()).hexdigest()
    ok &= put == '200' and same
    print(put, 'md5-ok' if same else 'MD5-MISMATCH', local, base)
print('ALL OK' if ok else 'PROBLEMS')
stage_batch.py
stage_put.py
```

This is st-artwork's read-only inventory for st-fable's composition spec. No new art. Raw data is in `art-inventory.json` here, produced by `artwork/scripts/art_inventory.py`.

**How to read the columns:**
- **Edges:** which image borders carry an opaque *cut*. A cut must sit on a viewport or section edge (bleed), or be hidden behind something.
  - "free" = a full silhouette that can float anywhere.
  - "feathered" = the cut already fades out.
- **Max CSS width:** the largest width that stays sharp at 2× (px ÷ 2); never stretch beyond it. At ≥1024 the chapter is usually 2× DPR, but laptops at 1.25–1.5× get more headroom.
- **Landing:**
  - "chapter" = already used in that set's landing chapter.
  - "hero" = used only in the hero.
  - "—" = not on the landing.
